name: Vivek Kumar
title: Junior Motion Graphic Designer
profile: Junior Motion Graphic Designer with a Dice Academy certification in motion design and about a year of hands-on design experience. I create logo animations, product films, social reels and UI animations in After Effects, built on a strong base in typography, layout and brand identity. At AlgoRoot I designed brand identities and product interfaces with dev and marketing teams, so my motion work starts from the brand and the user.

bullets: Rebuilt brand identity: redesigned the AlgoRoot logo and created a new visual identity for AlgoJob.
Redesigned the AlgoRoot website end to end, bringing clearer visual hierarchy, typography and consistency across pages.
Revamped the UI/UX of AlgoJob's AI career platform and redesigned the AlgoVox product interface.
Produced prototypes and high-fidelity Figma files with developer handoff documentation.
Worked with dev and marketing teams in an agile setup.

projects.name: VOLT 47
bullets: Animated an eight-second logo reveal with sound at 1920x1080 for a 24-hour gym identity, built on one mark read three ways: a 23° wedge, three barbell plates and a negative-space bolt.
Designed the identity behind it: logo suite, colour and type system (Anton + Space Grotesk), pattern, eight applications and a three-post social kit.

projects.name: CHASHNI
bullets: Edited three vertical reels in After Effects for a Diwali mithai brand, with voice and AI-generated kitchen footage, landing one line, "This one stops here", three different ways.
Designed the bilingual identity, print-ready packaging and three carousels the reels promote.

projects.name: FIKR
bullets: Made an After Effects film presenting a concept medicine-care app, after designing its research, flows, Material 3 design system and screens.

projects.name: Shady?
bullets: Made a launch film for a concept AI scam checker, alongside its personas, light and dark design system and screens.

projects.name: UI Motion Pieces
bullets: Carousel and parallax animations, a hover effect, an animated hero section for Palmonas and the Achilles layered parallax hero.
